nb: NB is a soft grey ductile metallic element used in alloys.
NB can also mean a Latin phrase used to indicate that special attention should be paid to something.
NB means the same as niobium or atomic number 41 or nota bene.
nbe: NbE is the compass point that is one point east of due north.
NbE means the same as north by east.
nbw: NbW is the compass point that is one point west of due north.
NbW means the same as north by west.
